verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt (HTTP 200), markdown versions of the doc pages that point agents to the llms.txt index, and a fetchable OpenAPI schema. First-party docs also list an LLM-optimized /llms-api.txt and a dedicated agent-instructions page with guidance such as cautions before money-moving calls. Missing for 10: /llms-api.txt was not itself probed, and there is no hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs end-to-end.
